Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment focuses on UFMylation, which is a ubiquitin-like modification. Although UFM1 is distinct from SUMO, the ontology provided maps UBL-remnant/SUMO-like workflows (QQTGG/SUMO) to the same modifier logic for remnant-based PTM analysis. The search parameters explicitly include a 'valine-glycine' dipeptide on Lysine (K), which is the UFM1 remnant motif, analogous to the diGly motif for ubiquitin.
